events.caption: proposes to stop the card settlement job.

detail.rationale: The root blocker (pid 93673) is a settlement_worker/protected_settlement session that has been idle in transaction for 4.0s with last statement 'SELECT 1', indicating it's stuck and not making progress. This single blocker is causing 12 sessions to wait on locks, directly impacting checkout with 4 timeouts in the last 15s (92% success rate vs expected higher SLO). Terminating this stuck session will immediately release its locks and unblock the 12 waiting sessions, restoring checkout throughput.
